exit: 0
--- stdout
usage: codebreaker xbox-disc <command> [options]

the files of an Xbox 360 disc image: list, read one, unpack all

commands:
  files   every file of the image: its size, a tab, its path
  read    one file of the image, written to a file (exit 3 when the image has none)
  unpack  every file of the image, written under a folder (what is there at its full size is kept)
--- files
--- stderr (not compared)
